funnel.question: Reach: can AI crawlers and fetchers get in?
Read: does the content exist without JavaScript?
Quote: can a machine lift a clean fact?
Trust: is it fresh, corroborated, unambiguous?
Retain: does the arriving visitor stay?

findings.title: No Organization or LocalBusiness entity declared
findings.mechanism: The Organization entity is the anchor that ties every fact and page to one unambiguous brand identity (appendix concept D).
findings.evidence: JSON-LD types found: ['SearchAction', 'WebSite']. None establishes who the brand itself is.

suggested_action.summary: Add one Organization (or LocalBusiness) JSON-LD block on the homepage with name, url, logo, description and sameAs links to official profiles.

findings.title: Missing the structured-data type a content site needs
findings.mechanism: Generic Organization schema names the brand but not its articles and authors; the page-type entity is what a machine lifts to answer questions about this kind of site.
findings.evidence: Detected site type is content, but no matching schema was found (present: ['SearchAction', 'WebSite']).

suggested_action.summary: Add Article or BlogPosting with author and datePublished to the relevant pages, alongside the sitewide Organization block.

findings.title: No usable XML sitemap found
findings.mechanism: Sitemaps are how crawlers find pages that navigation does not surface, and lastmod is a freshness signal.
findings.evidence: Tried https://python.org/sitemap.xml -> HTTP 404; robots.txt declares a sitemap: False.

suggested_action.summary: Publish /sitemap.xml with canonical URLs and lastmod dates, and declare it in robots.txt with a Sitemap: line.

findings.title: No machine-readable freshness signal anywhere
findings.mechanism: Systems prefer sources they can prove are current; with no dates they must assume the worst or trust a fresher competitor.
findings.evidence: No datePublished or dateModified in structured data and no lastmod dates in the sitemap across 9 sampled pages.

suggested_action.summary: Emit dateModified in Article or WebPage JSON-LD and lastmod in the sitemap, updated by the build pipeline, so machines can see the content is maintained.

proactive_recommendations.summary: Blog or news pages carry no author markup. Add visible bylines plus Person schema with author credentials; attributed content is weighted as more trustworthy by retrieval systems.
Navigation exposes 64 links. Consider collapsing to 5 to 7 top-level choices; oversized menus measurably slow orientation.

No /llms.txt. This is optional: no major AI provider has confirmed using it, so treat it as a cheap, low-risk curated index for agent tooling, not a fix for visibility problems. Prioritize the actual findings first.
